contract.task_clause:
Use the following key to translate the given formula of PL to natural, English sentences.
A: Marina reads a Percy Jackson book.
B: Izzy plays Minecraft.
C: Emily stops working.
D: Russell makes dinner.
E: Ashleigh stops by.
~C ∨ D
Option A: If Emily doesn't stop working then Russell makes dinner.
Option B: Emily stops working unless Russell makes dinner.
Option C: Emily stops working unless Russell doesn't make dinner.
Option D: Emily doesn't stop working unless Russell makes dinner.
